A '''Rotating Coupler''' was a component on [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries']] [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]]. Located at the back of the weapon, the Rotating Coupler was used to release a module that contained the weapon's internal components for maintenance and repair.<ref name="EGWT" />
